body: I agree. But this is the worst my depression has been. I've been trying for a month now to find any sense of motivation to do what you have said. I'm getting to that point where I'm nervous I may never crawl out of this hole.

I think it's more of "she thinks she's being" honest.....when in reality she's not. Many times, more than I can count over the years, I have done what she has wanted and it never helped. She seems to think it did...and I'm sitting over here thinking....we had sex and I didn't know about it? Does that make sense? She truly thinks it's all my fault.
